column1: # Install layout shared by every distribution package.
# Columns (tab-separated): mode, source (relative to the repository root),
# destination (absolute). Mode "tree" copies a directory recursively with
# 0755 directories and 0644 files, skipping Python bytecode. Mode "link"
# creates a symbolic link whose target is the source column, verbatim.
# Sources under build/i18n/ are generated by packaging/build-i18n.sh (compiled
# translations and the translated desktop and AppStream files); stage.sh runs
# it first. Everything else is a file in the repository.
# {pythondir} is the only distribution-specific token: the system Python
# Fedora: %{python3_sitelib}). Everything else is an FHS path that is the
# Consumed by packaging/stage.sh. Documentation files are installed by each
# distribution's own packaging, because doc and license locations differ.
